briefdescription.para: Builds the documents of the selected lines of an input.

detaileddescription.para: A range with no prefix and no carriage return is borrowed from the input, so the document is a view. A missing last newline is one more borrowed document. Otherwise the formatted lines are one document.

parameterdescription.para: The input that holds the bytes. Ownership passes to a borrowed document.
The display path of the input.
True when the input was named on the command line.

briefdescription.para: Stages the mutation of one file as one edit of the transaction.

detaileddescription.para: The file is read with Input::allBytes, so the document holds an owned copy of the bytes. A later write to the file cannot change those bytes.

parameterdescription.para: The transaction that receives the edit.
The file to mutate.
The display path of the file.

briefdescription.para: Resolves the mutation range against the line count, and checks its bounds.

detaileddescription.para: An open end becomes numLines + 1. An insertAfter may start at line 0 or at the last line, so an insertion can follow the last line. Every other mutation needs a range inside the lines.

parameterdescription.para: The document to mutate.
The display path of the document, used in the failure text.

simplesect.para: The result, and the half-open range of lines to mutate.

briefdescription.para: Checks the expected hash of the first line of the range, when one was given.

detaileddescription.para: A start line below 1 has no line to hash, so it fails whenever a hash is expected.

parameterdescription.para: The document to check.

simplesect.para: Ok when no hash is expected or the hash matches, otherwise the failure.
